body.x: Rapoo, announces three new wireless, portable audio solutions at CES 2013. The Bluetooth Portable Speaker A5000, Bluetooth Portable Mini Speaker A3060 and Bluetooth Portable Speaker A8060 all offer a compact design and powerful sound perfect for use at home or on the go.

Rapoo’s compact Bluetooth Portable Speaker A5000 is a Bluetooth 4.0 speaker available in a range of bright colors including lime green, watermelon pink, electric blue and basic black. The small speaker delivers powerful sound while on the go. It features a built-in microphone to double as a speakerphone for hands-free calls and a 3.5mm jack to connect mobile devices

The cylindrical Bluetooth Portable Mini Speaker A3060 features Bluetooth 4.0 and Intelligent Voice Prompt which provides audio status updates including when the speaker is pairing to a device, battery life and volume changes. Users can control volume, pause/play music and go to the next/previous track from the connected smartphone or via the integrated controls on the top of the speaker. The speaker has a built-in microphone for hands-free calling, a rechargeable lithium ion battery and comes in five different metallic shades - silver, green, orange, yellow and blue.

Rapoo’s sleek Bluetooth Portable Speaker A8060 has Bluetooth 4.0 connectivity and Guided Acoustic Wave (GAW) Technology. The powerful speaker features music enhancemnent-aptX™ technology which ensures the integrity of digital audio. The high quality speaker also has smart control buttons with a proximity sensor which illuminates the controls when the user is in range.
Rapoo’s new line-up of portable wireless audio solutions will be available in Q1 2013.
